title: Acceptance-check — agent verdict input
description: Written by the existing-app test agent to .github/.pipeline-context/verify/<id>.acceptance.verdict.json after reading <id>.acceptance.facts.md, then consumed by scripts/render-acceptance.js. Answers: does every acceptance criterion the story listed actually hold in the patched code?

verdict.description: SATISFIED: every acceptance criterion holds in the patched code. NOT_SATISFIED: at least one does not. INCONCLUSIVE: the facts bundle doesn't settle it (e.g. the worktree failed to apply).

plain_summary.description: One sentence a non-engineer would understand.

criteria_results.description: One entry per acceptance criterion listed in the facts bundle.

reasoning.description: Cite the patched source, not the developer's own narrative.
Overall reasoning tying the criteria results together.
